title: twists and stuff
description: a survival modpack with many different vanilla tweaks to make the game better ( release ! )
body:
twists and stuff is a very different modpack you wake up in a forest wondering what are you going to do but suddenly you understand you can't do anything but survive in the wild and make histories !

features :
player animations
first person     
           
animations inspired  by (actions and stuff) but not a copy

new weapons and tools awarded by killing the warden in ancient city 

new structures in end (including villages)

easier takeoff by elytra

note : don't update anything in this pack 

another note : this modpack is still in beta so you might face many glitches and bugs
